CORE FINDING (proposal, not applied): the --page-column-* tokens INHERIT, so a columns row nested inside a COLUMN inherits that column's three tokens. Measured on navigation/columns/ (a `full` page holding two demo.app column rows): a default-width demo column rendered 1202px inside a 1202px row, because it inherited --page-column-flex: 1 0 100% and --page-column-max: none from the `full` ancestor. Fix is one rule in Page.css: `.page.columns { --page-column-flex: initial; --page-column-min: initial; --page-column-max: initial; }` - `initial` on a custom property is the guaranteed-invalid value, so var(--x, fallback) falls back. Worked around locally with .paging-nav-demo .page.columns.
